# A page that leaks only if the identity vocabulary is loaded

The two lines at the end are invisible to every generic class. They are caught
only when the identity vocabulary is supplied — which is the whole reason an
empty or missing vocabulary must never be reported as clean.

The box answered on 192.168.1.42 once the bridge came up.
The overlay address was 100.101.102.103 for the whole run.
When DHCP failed it fell back to 169.254.10.1 and stayed there.
The log was written to /home/example/notes/work.md before promotion.
The runbook pasted a token inline: ghp_EXAMPLEONLYNOTAREALTOKENVALUE
The same runbook pasted -----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY----- and then the body.
Status was polled from https://buildbox.internal/status every thirty seconds.

The overnight build ran on bluefin and finished before anyone was awake.
The engagement it was built for was acmecorp.example, named here in passing.
